title: Agent: support provider+model split by auto-combining to provider/model
description: DSPyAgentHandle auto-configures the LM using config.model, but config.provider is currently unused for LM selection. This makes common Agent configs like provider="openai" + model="gpt-4o-mini" fail unless a global LM is already configured.\n\nFix: when provider is set and model has no provider prefix, combine into provider/model (or provider:model handling) before calling configure_lm. Add tests to ensure both (a) model already has prefix and (b) provider+model split work. Update docs/agent-primitive.md examples to reflect canonical behavior.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_acceptance_criteria:
- Agent configs with provider="openai" and model="gpt-4o-mini" auto-configure LM correctly in real mode
- Existing provider/model-prefixed configs still work
- Unit tests cover combination logic
- Docs match reality
custom.beads_close_reason: DSPyAgentHandle now normalizes model/provider to LiteLLM provider/model format (supports provider+model split, provider:model, and passthrough); added unit+integration tests; updated docs/agent-primitive.md; dspy test suite passes.
